svg.title: Ananya uses pulse and paper triage while Riju recognises his propagated confidence weighting.
svg.desc: Ananya times a different urgent resident's pulse with her mechanical watch and marks a paper triage slip. Riju recognises that the identity-confidence weighting generalised from his earlier correction now sits at the edge of this unrelated clinical decision.
